zh: 2 符号规范变换把问题化为 \(H_d=-\partial_x^2+1-\tfrac94W_x(d)^2\) 的正性。\(d=0\) 的精确 9 维有理数块、解析尾与交叉块给出 \(H_0\ge1/20\)；显式时间扰动再给 \(H_d\ge1/40\)。有限有理数块只是连续证明中的精确子证书。
en: 2 symbolic gauge transformations reduce the problem to the positivity of \(H_d=-\partial_x^2+1-\tfrac94W_x(d)^2\). At \(d=0\), the exact 9-dimensional rational block, together with the analytic tail and cross block, gives \(H_0\ge1/20\); an explicit time perturbation then gives \(H_d\ge1/40\). The finite rational block is only an exact subcertificate within the continuum proof.

en: The formal archive contains 319 primary records, 21 cutoff comparisons, 6 step-size comparisons, 4 preregistered independent sentinels, and 1 independent holdout. en: R0.73G retains only relative amplification; through actual-gain normalization and harmonic-energy localization, R0.73H makes the initial \(H^3\) norm tend to zero while the endpoint target row remains a fixed distance away. The price is a seed defined by the unknown actual gain and a background that also varies with the parameter. zh: R0.73H 在精确平面 Navier--Stokes 子系统内解析控制线性、二次、三次系数与四阶余项。以实际选定增益 \(G_\Lambda\) 归一化的初态 \(\delta\phi_\Lambda/G_\Lambda\) 在固定端点留下至少 \(\delta/2\) 的目标行幅度，而初始 \(H^3\) 范数趋于零。结论属于随 \(\Lambda\) 变化的背景族；预设下界指数种子、固定背景 Lyapunov 不稳定、横向三维、奇性与 Clay 均未由此得到。
en: Within the exact planar Navier--Stokes subsystem, R0.73H analytically controls the linear, quadratic, and cubic coefficients and the fourth-order remainder. Using the actual selected gain \(G_\Lambda\), the actual-gain-normalized seed \(\delta\phi_\Lambda/G_\Lambda\) leaves target-row amplitude of at least \(\delta/2\) at the fixed endpoint, while the initial \(H^3\) norm tends to zero. The conclusion is a varying-background planar fixed-distance departure indexed by \(\Lambda\); the prescribed lower-law seed, fixed-background Lyapunov instability, transverse three-dimensional dynamics, singularity, and Clay do not follow.
